events.label: July FOMC target unchanged
events.finding: Target range remained 3.50–3.75%; three dissenters preferred a 25bp increase.

events.label: Jackson Hole speech
events.finding: Warsh questioned whether financial conditions were restrictive and required clearer inflation progress; no commitment to a specific meeting action.

events.label: Treasury long-end liquidity buybacks announcement
events.boundary_note: Analytical next-day boundary for a date-only release, not an observed timestamp.
events.finding: Maximum nominal long-end liquidity buyback sizes rise from $2bn to at least $4bn per operation starting September 9. Announcement, not August execution or Fed QE.

events.label: Hormuz: US strikes Iranian targets
events.source: Axios reporting on CENTCOM; updated article
events.limit: Exact first publication and direct original CENTCOM release not archived; do not infer intraday order.

events.label: Gold decline and rate-hike discussion
events.usage: Contemporaneous competing policy/energy explanation; price statistics use frozen Yahoo/FRED, not the news quotation.

etf_monthly_supplement.reason: Date matches cutoff day but publication clock unknown; treat as later verified supplement, not information proven available at cutoff.
etf_monthly_supplement.limits: Rounded components need not sum exactly. One-month observation cannot date daily flows. AUM and WGC positioning aggregates not substituted for flows or CFTC futures-only positions.
